body:
Observed on #1546 (adds `wikisite` to `.dockerignore`): `Detect changed paths` ran, and
`Integration Tests (Docker)` came back SKIPPED.

A `.dockerignore` edit is close to the only change that is *always* build-affecting — it
decides what reaches the build context, and `Dockerfile:366` is a blanket
`COPY --chown=abc:abc . /app/calibre-web-automated/`. An over-broad line there removes a
path the image needs, and no PR check would catch it. The failure would first appear on
the `:dev` build after merge, which is after the point where a PR check is useful.

Same argument applies to the neighbours: verify whether `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore` and
the compose files are all classified as docker-lane triggers, not just `Dockerfile`.

#1546 itself is safe — verified by inspection that nothing outside `wikisite/` references
the path, and it is the consistent sibling of `cwa-wiki`, `wiki_images` and `wiki-src`,
which are already ignored. The finding is about the lane that should have proven it and
did not run.
title: The CI path filter treats .dockerignore as non-build-affecting, so the Docker lane skips the one file that always is
